name: Chicken Cutlets with Lemony Brussels Sprout, Cranberry & Walnut Sauté

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb Brussels sprouts
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve Brussels sprouts; transfer to a medium bowl and set aside.
Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, sprinkle flour over both sides of each cutlet and press gently to adhere.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add cutlets and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel and mince onion and garlic.
When the chicken is done, remove to a plate and cover loosely with aluminum foil.
Return pot to medium-high heat, add additional oil, and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and garlic to the pot; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, 1-2 minutes.
Add Brussels sprouts, broth, cranberries, and salt to the pot; cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until Brussels sprouts are fork-tender, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cups dried cranberries
salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in the bowl used for the Brussels sprouts.
Juice lemons into the bowl with the parsley.
Roughly chop walnuts and add to the bowl.
Uncover the pot, then add the parsley, lemon juice, and walnuts. Stir to combine and remove from the heat.
To serve, divide chicken and Brussels sprout sauté between plates. Enjoy!
